attempts.cause: The view ACTIVE_STAFF_V incorrectly filters out staff whose end_date is in the past, but the requirement seems to be to count all staff who are currently employed, which should include staff whose end_date is NULL (meaning they are still active).
attempts.candidate:
create or replace view active_staff_v as
-- Staff still employed: no end date yet, or an end date today or later.
select staff_id, full_name, dept_code
  from staff
 where end_date is null or end_date >= trunc(sysdate)
/
